meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw可以通过Baileys适配器直接连接你的WhatsApp账号，读取和发送消息。共享号码时，只处理你自己的聊天，不读取他人消息。
howto.when: 当你提出添加WhatsApp的要求时触发。过程包括：确认号码类型（专用或共享）、复制文件并安装依赖，然后通过扫描QR码或输入配对码完成身份验证。

say.note: 输入电话号码生成配对码。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw can connect directly to your WhatsApp account via the Baileys adapter to read and send messages. For a shared number, it only handles your self-chat, ignoring others' messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to add WhatsApp. Steps include: confirm number type (dedicated or shared), copy files and install dependencies, then authenticate via QR code scan or pairing code.

say_en.text: Help me connect my WhatsApp with a QR code.
say_en.note: Starts the QR code authentication flow.

say_en.text: Connect via pairing code, number is 13912345678.
say_en.note: Generates a pairing code for the given phone number.
Shows whether the connection is successful.
